name: Yolca Yulewood
original_name: ヨルカ・ユールウッド
source:
[i]“...Why do you have so much hope for me?”[/i]

[i]Weaver of Fate[/i]

A girl buried as dead. Her feeble body houses a sharp resolve, and she travels the world using the beauty she inherited from her mother as a shield. She respects her philanthropist parents, and longs to use her own assets for the benefit of others.

Though she's done everything she can to return to House Yulewood, very few believe their blood flows in her veins. Due to her lack of strength, she carries knives and stun guns for self-defense. Due to her impressive stock, those in her inner circle wonder if she's an arms dealer.

As a true realist, she staunchly believes she can't reach her ideals without getting her hands dirty. Contrary to that, though, she's distressed by the tears of others.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=yolca]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
